summary: Hardened the farm_studio_api verdict classifier and CLI evidence loading. Actual numeric process exits are required for completion, final candidates require a saved-source claim corroborated by SHA-256 of supplied source bytes, and fixed holdout success requires both explicit report success and a successful actual capture with the required output marker. Added classifier and real CLI-path regression tests while preserving status/count fields and overwrite protections.
tests_run: functions.tests: public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs; 10 tests passed, 0 failed (exit code 0).

Candidate regression tests exercised the CLI module in-process against temporary case directories, including valid evidence, missing/changed source, missing/malformed holdout, missing/failed turn captures, and historical verdict overwrite refusal.
limitations: Evidence is validated from provided local files; no compiler or fixed-holdout executable was run independently.
CLI tests invoke the real module entry path in-process rather than spawning a separate Node process, consistent with available tool permissions.
The holdout output contract is the specified line prefix; no additional expectations-count format or unrelated evidence-array schema is imposed.
